name: Starcaller Starsunder has no stuck cooldown and casts repeatedly (#8972)
contract: Starsunder 801127 (Starcaller's baseline rank 1, learnable at level 1) carries RecoveryTime=0 and
CategoryRecoveryTime=0 in the DBC: only the standard 1250 ms GCD (StartRecoveryCategory 133) applies, with
no real spell cooldown that could get stuck. No C++ in AscensionStarcallerAbilities.cpp/
AscensionStarcallerEvents.cpp adds, extends or locks a cooldown for this spell. This proves the mechanic:
cast Starsunder, confirm its cooldown clears to 0 well before any plausible stuck-cooldown window, then cast
it again immediately and confirm it lands a second time with no cast failure.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Weapon proficiency (Starsunder is a normalized-weapon-damage effect)
The first cast is not rejected
Let the 1250 ms GCD (StartRecoveryCategory 133) clear fully before the next cast
Its cooldown is 0 once the GCD has elapsed; nothing keeps it stuck
The second cast is not rejected either
DISCRIMINATING: the second cast lands too, back to back
